topics.title: Coursework & Learning Support
topics.summary: As a general rule, AI use is permitted in teaching and in support of learning to achieve learning outcomes, subject to specific instructions set by course coordinators.
topics.scope: Studies Service official teaching & learning guidelines
topics.evidenceScope: Studies Service official teaching & learning guidelines

claims.text: General rule permits AI use in teaching and learning if pedagogically justified; course coordinators decide on rules for their courses.

evidence.quote: As a rule, AI use is permitted in teaching and in support of learning. AI use must support the achievement of course learning outcomes and be pedagogically justified.
evidence.title: Using AI to support learning (University of Helsinki Studies Service)
evidence.location: Using AI to support learning > Artificial intelligence guidelines in a nutshell

topics.title: Mandatory AI Disclosure
topics.summary: In written work, students must disclose their use or non-use of AI according to separate instructions, even if individual courses do not specifically request it.

claims.text: In written work, students must disclose their use or non-use of AI according to separate instructions, even if individual courses do not specifically request it.

evidence.quote: In written work, you must disclose your use or non-use of AI in accordance with separate instructions, even when not specifically instructed to do so in individual courses.
evidence.title: Using AI to support learning (University of Helsinki Studies Service)
evidence.location: Using AI to support learning > Guidelines for disclosing generative AI use
